collection.title: Ford Focus Saloon 1998 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Focus Saloon 1998 - 2005 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and a 19" passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
